findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: Passing an attacker-controlled string to printf without proper validation
findings.assumptions: The main function calls is_balanced with strings that are not controlled by the attacker. However, if the input to is_balanced comes from an untrusted source, it could lead to command injection.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: Pushing more symbols onto the stack than its capacity (MAX_SIZE)
findings.assumptions: The input to is_balanced is not validated to ensure it does not exceed the stack's capacity. If the input is attacker-controlled, it could lead to a buffer overflow.
